commit_subject: (screen-flagged) b1.6 (PR #1300): removes hard-coded exemplar entry_is_line_a..e derived rules (proof atoms citing other chapters' HTS lines) from every generated chapter and makes them caller inputs; summary claims runtime semantics unchanged — unsure, part of the same decoupling repair.
description: The generated compositions move from the witness's five per-line exemplar flags to membership-semantic caller inputs

triage.pre_fix_wrong_because: Chapter 15 (animal and vegetable fats and oils) derived entry_is_line_a..e from five out-of-chapter HTS statistical reporting numbers with proof atoms citing other chapters' provisions, so the trade-action components gated on those flags rested on conditions with no basis in this chapter's cited source.
triage.triage_notes: Same pattern as index 12; diff read individually and normalized-compared — only cosmetic difference is the redundant-parenthesis depth (8 pairs instead of 7) used by the placement gate. Same caveats as index 12.
triage.verifier_justification: The pre-fix chapter 15 (fats and oils) composition defined five derived conditions keyed on statistical reporting numbers belonging to other chapters — 7202.11.10.00 (ferroalloy), 7601.10.30.00 (aluminum wire), 9506.62.40.40 ("Footballs"), 2203.00.00.30 ("Beer made from malt"), 8541.42.00.10 ("Crystalline silicon photovoltaic cells") — with proof atoms citing those out-of-chapter provisions, and those flags gated this chapter's §301 list rates, §201 solar, §338 alcohol, Brazil IEEPA exception and the §122 surcharge carve-out (post file lines 2993-2997, 2571, 3038, 3196). No chapter-15 entry can carry those numbers, so every trade-action branch in this module rested on a condition with no basis in chapter 15's own cited lines; the fix deletes the five derived rules and the encoded meaning changes from constant-false-in-this-chapter to caller-supplied (the companion test correspondingly drops the five `hts_number` positive-coverage cases and adds `#input.entry_is_line_a..e`). That is a formula grounded on the wrong provision, which the untraceable_branch definition explicitly covers, and the generator diff states the rule normatively: "generated compositions must not derive them from the five hand-built witness HTS exemplars." I tried to refute it as mechanical or as pure architecture and could not: rules and the input surface changed, and the PR body itself calls the exemplar coupling a thing that "unlawfully suppressed the surcharge on §301-member lines for all origins."

triage.verifier_notes: Residual doubt, and why I held at 0.7 rather than higher: the repair is partial for this module. The branches themselves survive unchanged — `if entry_is_line_a and origin_is_china: list_1_additional_ad_valorem_rate`, `if entry_is_line_a or entry_is_line_b: 0` on the §122 temporary import surcharge and on the forced-labor §301 component are byte-identical pre and post; only the local derivations are deleted. The PR body's "membership-semantic" re-grounding (a/b/d → lists 1/2/3, c → list 4A) reaches ch15 only as prose in `module.summary` ("caller inputs supplied by entry preparation from incidence classification ... referenced-implies-input convention"), with no proof atom binding entry_is_line_a to a §301 list-membership provision, and the five out-of-chapter citations (us/statute/hts/7202.11.10.00, /7601.10.30.00, /9506.62.40.40, /2203.00.00.30, /8541.42.00.10) remain in the module's source_verification set after the fix. So a reviewer could reasonably call this a boundary/ownership refactor that moves an ungrounded derivation to the caller rather than a full source-fidelity correction inside ch15. Two further facts for the reviewer: `git log -- us/policies/cbp/us-tariff-schedule/generated/ch15/ch15.yaml` shows only two commits ever (the b1.3 generation 1bc7292fa and this one), so the component-decoupling work the PR body describes for `section_122_component_rate` never landed in this file; and the boilerplate sentence "changes no formula tokens, dates, inputs, proof atoms, or runtime values" is retained in the new summary and is literally false about inputs and proof atoms for this commit — it describes the placement-variant serialization, not the flag change. Same defect applies identically to all 100 generated chapter modules in this commit; treat them as one instance, not 100.
